item.title: How to connect to Azure SQL Database from SSMS
item.description:
Connecting to Azure SQL Database from SSMS: Troubleshooting Guide

Connecting to an Azure SQL Database from Microsoft SQL Server Management Studio (SSMS) can be challenging due to various reasons. In this troubleshooting guide, we’ll explore common causes of connection issues and provide steps to fix them.

Common Causes of Connection Issues

1. Incorrect Connection String

The connection string is a common culprit for connection issues. Ensure it is correctly formatted for a successful connection.

item.title: What is Trigger in SQL? 2023
item.description:
Trigger is a special type of stored procedure that is executed automatically in response to certain events on a database table Triggers are used to enforce business rules, maintain data integrity, and perform tasks such as auditing.

Triggers can be activated by various events, such as INSERT , UPDATE , DELETE , or SELECT statements on a table, or by direct invocation using the EXECUTE or CALL statement. Triggers can also be activated by database events such as logon, logoff, or server startup.
